rawItems.title: Parish Council Governance: Highway Contractor Penalties & Flaxon Walk Parking Bay
rawItems.content: Confirmed that the disabled parking bay at Flaxon Walk was completed that day, ahead of the anticipated timescale. Reported that LGR will affect highway maintenance contractors. Advised that, from September, if highway repairs are carried out to an unsatisfactory standard, councillors should report them to him. New reporting arrangements will be introduced, and contractors may face financial penalties for poor-quality work. Confirmed he is happy to assist by reporting highway issues where necessary.

rawItems.title: County Council Reports £60m SEND Budget Overspend
rawItems.content: Reported that Cambridgeshire County Council is forecasting a £60 million overspend on Special Educational Needs and Disabilities (SEND), representing around 50% of the service's budget. Advised that, despite the significant overspend, there has not yet been any noticeable improvement in the service and encouraged councillors to report any specific SEND issues so that they can be raised. Cllr S. White suggested that it may be worthwhile contacting the local school to discuss any SEND-related concerns and gather further information.

rawItems.content: Reviewed communication channels with leadership. Action agreed to simplify key messages, improve cross-device consistency, and clarify usage between email and ClassDojo. Decisions regarding outdoor events (e.g. Sports Day) balance weather safety, staffing workload, and parent availability.

rawItems.title: Parent Forum Minutes: Playground Surfaces & Field Drainage Improvements
rawItems.content: Ongoing discussions with leadership regarding school field drainage and playground surfaces. Academy leadership is exploring cost-effective maintenance and surface improvement options for the upcoming municipal year.

rawItems.title: Parent Forum Minutes: Curriculum Celebrations & Enrichment Highlights
rawItems.content: Celebrated success of Spanish Tasting Day, visiting theatre production company, and popular pupil Book Exchange / Book Club. High positive feedback from children across key stages.

rawItems.title: Parent Forum Minutes: Online Safety & Social Media Age Guidance (13+)
rawItems.content: Addressed concerns regarding under-age access to social media platforms. Reminded families that platforms require users to be 13+. School is reinforcing online safety guidance alongside parental oversight.

rawItems.title: Parent Forum Minutes: PTFA Flexible Event Volunteering Model
rawItems.content: To relieve pressure on committee members, PTFA is transitioning toward flexible event-by-event parent volunteering rather than full committee membership. Encouraging early parent involvement at new intake meetings.
